versions.changelog:
## Anglers Loot 1.0

First release.

- About half as much junk when fishing: the junk weight goes from 10 to 5.
- Treasure about one and a half times as often: the treasure weight goes from 5 to 8, still only in open water.
- Two new treasure catches: the heart of the sea (rare) and one to three bottles o' enchanting.
- The vanilla treasures stay about as likely per cast as before, and Luck of the Sea still lowers junk and raises treasure; at level III no junk is caught at all.

## Anglers Loot 1.1

Now also for Minecraft 26.3.

- The same zip works on Minecraft 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3: the fishing loot is included in the format each version reads.
- Same chances and the same two new treasure catches on every version, treasure still only in open water; nothing changes on 1.21 and 1.21.1.

## Anglers Loot 1.2

Biome catches: the fish you catch now depend on where you fish.

- Warm oceans, jungles and mangrove swamps: tropical fish make up about one in five fish (vanilla: one in fifty).
- Frozen rivers, frozen oceans and taigas: salmon make up two in five fish (vanilla: one in four).
- Cold oceans: cod make up about two in three fish, a little more than elsewhere.
- Everywhere else the fish are as in vanilla. Junk, treasure and fish stay exactly as likely as in 1.1, in every biome; only which fish you get changes.
- Works on Minecraft 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3, like before.

## Anglers Loot 1.3

A new advancement tab, Angler's Logbook, with 13 advancements about fishing.

- Catch each fish with a rod: cod, salmon, tropical fish and pufferfish.
- Biome catches: a tropical fish in a warm ocean, jungle or mangrove swamp, a salmon in a frozen river, frozen ocean or taiga, and a cod in a cold ocean.
- Treasure: fish up any treasure, an enchanted book, a bottle o' enchanting and the rare heart of the sea.
- Two challenges: Full Creel (catch all four fish) and Sunken Hoard (fish up every treasure).
- Only real catches count, not reeling in mobs or dropped items. Some advancements give experience, none give items.
- The fishing loot stays exactly as in 1.2. Works on Minecraft 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3 as before.
